HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/10/2023

These applications for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. have been filed by the petitioners who have been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.191/2023 registered at Police Station Shastri Nagar, District Jodhpur, for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 465,
466, 471 and 120-B of IPC and under Sections 3, 7 and 10 of the Rajasthan Public Examination Act,
2022.

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that challan has already been filed against the petitioners Ramchandra @ Ramesh and Raju Ram Vishnoi.
Learned counsel further submitted that no recovery is due to be effected from the present petitioners-Ramchandra @ Ramesh and Raju Ram Vishnoi.

Lastly, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners are in judicial custody since 30.07.2023 and 06.08.2023 respectively and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioners.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail applications.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, and keeping in view the fact that the allegation against the Ramchandra @ Ramesh-petitioner in S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No.11222/2023 is that he appeared in the REET Examination-2022 as a dummy candidate in place of one Raju Ram Vishnoi petitioner in S.B. Criminal [2023:RJ-JD:36043] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11222/2023] Miscellaneous Bail Application No.11223/2023 ; challan has already been filed; no recovery is due to be effected from the present petitioners; trial is not likely to be completed in near future and without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail applications filed by the petitioners deserve to be accepted.
Consequently, these bail applications under Section 439 Cr.P.C. are allowed.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No.11222/2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is ordered that the accused-petitioners (1).Ramchandra @ Ramesh S/o Bhoma Ram and (2).Raju Ram Vishnoi S/o Ramkishan Vishnoi arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.191/2023 registered at Police Station Shastri Nagar, District Jodhpur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided each of them furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for their appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
A copy of this order be placed in each file.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 79-80-KshamaD/-
